rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs approved by the State Board of Psychology, Ohio Psychological Association, Ohio Association of Black Psychologists or APA (school psychology: also State Board of Education, OSPA, NASP); completion must be recorded with OPA or OSPA
rules.new_licensee_rule: Licensed in 1st year of the biennium: 13 hours (incl. 4 h ethics/conduct/culture); licensed in first 3 months of 2nd year: exempt; licensed in last 9 months of 2nd year: 23 hours for the next renewal.
rules.audit_note: Board accepts only CE records registered with OPA/OSPA; keep certificates 3 years; Board may audit.
rules.notes: 4 h may be in professional conduct, ethics and/or role of culture/ethnic identity in assessment and interventions. CE due Aug 31, registration Sept 30 of even years. Up to 7 h for volunteer services to indigent/uninsured (not toward the 4 h). Optional Board-approved domestic violence course.
rules.legal_basis: Ohio Rev. Code 4732.141, 4732.14; Ohio Adm. Code 4732-2-01

rules.accepted_credit_types: Programs approved by State Board of Education, OSPA, NASP, OPA or APA; recorded with OSPA
rules.alternatives: Prescribed professional development plan through employing district (LPDC report), valid NCSP credential, or holding a permanent ODEW school psychologist license.
rules.new_licensee_rule: Licensed in first 3 years of the 5-year period: 28 hours by next renewal; 4th year: exempt; final year: first license for 6 years.
rules.notes: Quinquennial: CE due Aug 31 of years ending in 0 or 5; 4 h in professional conduct, ethics and/or culture/ethnic identity.
rules.legal_basis: Ohio Rev. Code 4732.141(A)(1)(b), 4732.14(B); Ohio Adm. Code 4732-2-01(D)
